content: ByteDance’s legacy “racehorse” internal competition mechanism hinders its large model development. Designed for rapid app iterations, this approach fragments resources and creates silos, unsuited for the coordinated, infrastructure-heavy demands of LLM training. To succeed, ByteDance must restructure toward centralized coordination and long-term research tolerance, moving away from its traditional fragmented organizational model.
